ipxact:register.ipxact:name: SMBUS_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: SMBus Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SMBSUS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode control: asserts the `smbsus_no` output.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SMBALERT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode control: asserts the `smbalert_no` output. This bit clears itself when the controller addresses this target.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ENABLEHOST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: configures this device's operating mode. * `ENABLEHOST = 1` and `ENABLETARGET = 0` — Controller Mode * `ENABLEHOST = 0` and `ENABLETARGET = 1` — Target Mode * `ENABLEHOST = 1` and `ENABLETARGET = 1` — Hybrid Mode * `ENABLEHOST = 0` and `ENABLETARGET = 0` — Monitor Mode

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ENABLETARGET
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: configures this device's operating mode. * `ENABLEHOST = 1` and `ENABLETARGET = 0` — Controller Mode * `ENABLEHOST = 0` and `ENABLETARGET = 1` — Target Mode * `ENABLEHOST = 1` and `ENABLETARGET = 1` — Hybrid Mode * `ENABLEHOST = 0` and `ENABLETARGET = 0` — Monitor Mode

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LLPBK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: enables line loop-back. In Controller Mode, the internal logic sees the `smbalert_ni` input as deasserted. In Target Mode, this target sends all received SDA data back out, and the internal logic sees received data as all 1's.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: NACK_ADDR_AFTER_TIMEOUT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode control: NACK address after timeout. If this bit is: * `0` - This target ACKs the address byte even if a Stretch Timeout occurs (useful for SMBus). * `1` - This target NACKs the address byte when a Stretch Timeout occurs.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACK_CTRL_EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode control: enables the Software ACK Control Mechanism. If this bit is: * `0` - This target ACKs a data byte whenever the ACQ FIFO has space. * `1` - This target ACKs the first `TARGET_ACK_CTRL.NBYTES` bytes. If another byte arrives, this target stretches the clock and awaits software intervention (and asserts `STATUS.ACK_CTRL_STRETCH`). The software can 1. accept the new byte(s) by reloading the `TARGET_ACK_CTRL.NBYTES` counter; or 2. reject the new byte(s) by writing `1` to `TARGET_ACK_CTRL.NACK` (useful for SMBus).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MULTI_CONTROLLER_MONITOR_EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Global control: enables the Bus Monitor. Set this bit to `1` only in a multi-controller environment.
If a `0`->`1` transition happens while `ENABLEHOST` and `ENABLETARGET` are both `0`, the Bus Monitor will enable and begin in the 'Bus Busy' state. To transition to a 'Bus Free' state, `HOST_TIMEOUT_CTRL` must be nonzero so the Bus Monitor may count out idle cycles to confirm the freedom to transmit. In addition, the Bus Monitor will track whether the bus is free based on the enabled timeouts and detected STOP symbols. For Multi-Controller Mode, ensure `MULTI_CONTROLLER_MONITOR_EN` becomes `1` no later than `ENABLEHOST` or `ENABLETARGET`. This bit can be set at the same time as either or both of the other two, though.
Note that if `MULTI_CONTROLLER_MONITOR_EN` is set after `ENABLEHOST` or `ENABLETARGET`, the Bus Monitor will begin in the 'Bus Free' state instead. This would violate the proper protocol for a controller to join a multi-controller environment. However, if this controller is known to be the first to join, this ordering will enable skipping the idle wait.
When `0`, the bus monitor will report that the bus is always free, so the Controller FSM is never blocked from transmitting.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_STRETCH_CTRL_EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target mode control: enables the Software TX Stretch Control Mechanism. If this bit is: * `0` - Automatic TX Stretch: When this target receives a READ address byte, it only stretches the clock if the TX FIFO is empty; otherwise, it pops the FIFO and transmits the data byte. The target never sets the `TARGET_EVENTS` register flags in this mode. * `1` - Software TX Stretch Mode: When this target receives a READ address, it always stretches the clock and sets the `TARGET_EVENTS.TX_PENDING` flag. The software can: 1. confirm the release and transmission of the TX FIFO data by writing a 1 to clear the `TARGET_EVENTS.TX_PENDING` flag; or 2. reset the TX FIFO by writing 1 to `FIFO_CTRL.TXRST` and load in new data via the `TXDATA` register--useful whenthe READ address is targeting a different function of the target. In this mode, the target always sets the `TARGET_EVENTS` register flags.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQ_START_STOP_EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: ACQ FIFO Start/Stop Enable (Target Mode only): * `0` - Start/Stop symbols are NOT written into the ACQ FIFO. The firmware should rely on `TARGET_EVENTS.START_DETECT` and `TARGET_EVENTS.STOP_DETECT` flags to detect Start/Stop events. * `1` - Start/Stop symbols ARE written into the ACQ FIFO (legacy behavior). When a START (or repeated START) is detected, an `ACQ_START` or `ACQ_RESTART` entry is written. When a STOP is detected, an `ACQ_STOP` or `ACQ_NACK_STOP` entry is written.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Status Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FMTFULL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode status: Controller TX FIFO Full.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RXFULL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode status: Controller RX FIFO Full.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FMTEMPTY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode status: Controller TX FIFO Empty.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: HOSTIDLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode status: Controller FSM idle.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TARGETIDLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode status: Target FSM idle.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RXEMPTY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode status: Controller RX FIFO empty.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TXFULL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode status: Target TX FIFO full.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQFULL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode status: Target RX FIFO full.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TXEMPTY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode status: Target TX FIFO empty.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQEMPTY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode status: Target RX FIFO empty.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACK_CTRL_STRETCH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode status: indicates that this target is stretching the clock due to the Software ACK Control Mechanism. See `CTRL.ACK_CTRL_EN` for details.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: RDATA
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controller RX FIFO Access Register (Controller Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DATA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reading this register pops the Controller RX FIFO.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: FDATA
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controller TX FIFO Access Register (Controller Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FBYTE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing to this register pushes an entry into the Controller TX FIFO. The meaning of this field depends on the value of the `READB` field: * `READB = 0` - This field is the WRITE data byte. * `READB = 1` - This field specifies the number of bytes to read from the target. Setting this field to 0 reads 256 bytes.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: START
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Generate a START condition on the bus before sending the byte.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STOP
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Generate a STOP condition on the bus after sending the byte.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READB
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Read/write: * `0` - Issue WRITE transaction * `1` - Issue READ transaction

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RCONT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Read continue/stop: * `0` — Read Stop: The controller NACKs the last data byte. Use this if this is the last READ in a sequence. * `1` — Read Continue: The controller ACKs the last data byte. Use this if this is an intermediate READ in a sequence.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: NAKOK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: NACK OK. When set, this controller will not care if this byte is NACKed. It will not halt, set the `CONTROLLER_EVENTS.NACK` flag, or assert the `CONTROLLER_HALT` Interrupt. This behavior is useful for protocols like Serial Camera Control Bus (SCCB).

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: FIFO_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: FIFO Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RXRST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode control: writing `1` resets the Controller RX FIFO.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FMTRST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode control: writing `1` resets the Controller TX FIFO.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQRST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode control: writing `1` resets the Target RX FIFO.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TXRST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode control: writing `1` resets the Target TX FIFO.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: HOST_FIFO_CONFIG
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controller FIFO Configuration Register (Controller Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_THRESH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The `RX_THRESH` interrupt remains asserted while the Controller RX FIFO level is greater than this setting.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FMT_THRESH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The `FMT_THRESH` interrupt remains asserted while the Controller TX FIFO level is less than this setting.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TARGET_FIFO_CONFIG
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target FIFOs Configuration Register (Target Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_THRESH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The `TX_THRESH` interrupt remains asserted while the Target TX FIFO level is less than this setting.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQ_THRESH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The `ACQ_THRESH` interrupt remains asserted while the Target RX FIFO level is greater than this setting.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: HOST_FIFO_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controller FIFOs Status Register (Controller Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FMTLVL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller TX FIFO fill level.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RXLVL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller RX FIFO fill level.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TARGET_FIFO_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target FIFOs Status Register (Target Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TXLVL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target TX FIFO fill level.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQLVL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target RX FIFO fill level.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: OVRD
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Override Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TXOVRDEN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: enables control of the SDA and SCL lines through the `SDA_VAL` and `SCL_VAL` fields, respectively.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SCLVAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: SCL override value: * `0` - Pull the SCL line low * `1` - Release the SCL line

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SDAVAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: SDA override value: * `0` - Pull the SDA line low * `1` - Release the SDA line

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: VAL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Bus Oversampled Values Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SCL_RX
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global status: contains the last 16 SCL over-sampled values. LSB is most recent.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SDA_RX
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global status: contains the last 16 SDA over-sampled values. LSB is most recent.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMING0
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: SCL LOW and HIGH Periods Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: THIGH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the HIGH period of SCL (`t_HIGH`) in system clock cycles. Must be `≥ 2`. See Table 11 in the I²C Specification for details. This field is sized to meet the I2C Standard-mode (100 kHz)'s minimum `t_HIGH = 4.0 μs` requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TLOW
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the LOW period of SCL (`t_LOW`) in system clock cycles. Must be `≥ 2`. See Table 11 in the I2C Specification for more details. This field is sized to meet the I2C Standard-mode (100 kHz) minimum `t_LOW = 4.7 μs` requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMING1
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Bus Rise and Fall Times Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: T_R
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the rise time of SDA and SCL (`t_r`) in system clock cycles. The rise time is measured from 30% to 70% of the signal swing. See Table 11 in the I2C Specification for more details. This field is sized to meet I2C Standard-mode (100 kHz)'s maximum `t_r = 1000 ns` requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: T_F
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the fall time of SDA and SCL (`t_f`) in system clock cycles. The fall time is measured from 70% to 30% of the signal swing. See Table 11 in the I2C Specification for more details. This field is sized to meet I2C Standard-mode (100 kHz)'s maximum `t_f = 300 ns` requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMING2
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: START Condition Setup and Hold Times Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TSU_STA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the setup time for a repeated START condition (`t_SU;STA`) in system clock cycles. See Table 11 in the I2C Specification for details. This field is sized to meet I2C Standard-mode (100 kHz)'s minimum `t_SU;STA = 4.7 μs` requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: THD_STA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the setup time for a (repeated) START condition (`t_HD;STA`) in system clock cycles. See Table 11 in the I2C Specification for details. This field is sized to meet I2C Standard-mode (100 kHz)'s minimum `t_HD;STA = 4.0 μs` requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMING3
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Data Setup and Hold Times Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TSU_DAT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the data setup time (`t_SU;DAT`) in system clock cycles. See Table 11 in the I2C Specification for details. This field is sized to meet the I2C Standard-mode (100 kHz)'s `t_SU;DAT = 250 ns` minimum requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: THD_DAT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the data and (N)ACK bits hold time (`t_HD;DAT`) in system clock cycles. See Table 11 in the I2C Specification for details. This field is sized to meet the I2C Standard-mode (100 kHz)'s `t_HD;DAT = 5.0 μs` minimum requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMING4
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: STOP Condition Setup Time and Bus Free Time Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TSU_STO
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the setup time for a STOP condition (`t_SU;STO`) in system clock cycles. See Table 11 in the I²C Specification for details. This field is sized to meet I2C Standard-mode (100 kHz)'s `t_SU;STO = 4.0 μs` minimum requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: T_BUF
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the time between a STOP and START condition (`t_BUF`) in system clock cycles. See Table 11 in the I²C Specification for details. This field is sized to meet I2C Standard-mode (100kHz)'s `t_BUF = 4.7 μs` minimum requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMEOUT_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Timeout Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: VAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: Specifies the timeout value in system clock cycles. The meaning of this field depends on `MODE`.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MODE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: timeout mode. * `0` - Stretch Timeout (Controller Mode only). If the target stretches the clock for more time than `TIMEOUT_CTRL.VAL`, the `STRETCH_TIMEOUT` interrupt will be asserted. * `1` - Bus Timeout. If SCL is LOW for more time than `TIMEOUT_CTRL.VAL`: * In Controller Mode, the `CONTROLLER_EVENTS.BUS_TIMEOUT` flag will be asserted, triggering the `CONTROLLER_HALT` interrupt. * In Target Mode, the `TARGET_EVENTS.BUS_TIMEOUT` flag will be set, triggering the `TX_STRETCH` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Timeout Enable.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TARGET_ID
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target ID Register (Target Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ADDRESS0
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Address 0. This target responds if the 7-bit address matches `ADDRESS0 & MASK0`. `MASK0 = 0x0` disables this address.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MASK0
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: ADDRESS0 mask.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ADDRESS1
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Address 1. This target responds if the 7-bit address matches `ADDRESS1 & MASK1`. `MASK1 = 0x0` disables this address.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MASK1
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: ADDRESS1 mask.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: ACQDATA
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target RX FIFO Access Register (Target Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ABYTE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reading this register pops the ACQ FIFO. The meaning of this field depends on `SIGNAL`: * `SIGNAL = 0x0`, `0x1`, `0x3`, `0x4`, or `0x5` - This field contains an address or data byte sent by the controller. * `SIGNAL = 0x2`, `0x6` - This field is meaningless.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SIGNAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
This field indicates if this FIFO entry represents/is associated with control signal(s): * `0x0` - The entry is an ordinary data byte that has been ACKed. * `0x1` - The entry is an address byte preceded by a START. * `0x2` - The entry is a STOP condition following ACKed data bytes. * `0x3` - The entry is an address byte preceded by a repeated START. * `0x4` - The entry is a NACKed data byte. * `0x5` - The entry is an address byte preceded by a (repeated) START. However, the data bytes that followed this address byte were NACKed. * `0x6` - Error. A transaction preceding ended abnormally, for example, due to an unexpected STOP condition, a Bus or Stretch Timeout, a software NACK, or a lost arbitration.
If the FIFO does not have enough space to record a complete transaction, an Error (`0x6`) entry may appear alone.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TXDATA
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target TX FIFO Access Register (Target Mode only).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DATA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing to this register pushes data into the Target TX FIFO. The controller reads data from this FIFO during a READ transaction.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: HOST_TIMEOUT_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controller Timeout Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: VAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target/Monitor Mode control: controller clock generation timeout value specified in system clock cycles. * Target Mode - If the controller stops generating the clock for more time than this setting, this target asserts the Controller Timeout Interrupt. * Monitor Mode - this field is required to be nonzero for the Bus Monitor to transition out of the initial Busy state. Set this field to `0x0` to disable this behavior.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TARGET_TIMEOUT_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target Timeout Control Register (Target Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: VAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
When this target has stretched the clock for more time than this setting, this target will NACK incoming data bytes or release the SDA line for outgoing data bytes. The count is cumulative over an entire transaction. In other words, this is SMBus's cumulative target clock extension time.
The behavior for the address byte is configurable via `CTRL.NACK_ADDR_AFTER_TIMEOUT`.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable Target Timeout.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TARGET_NACK_COUNT
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target NACK Count Register (Target Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TARGET_NACK_COUNT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates the number of transactions NACKed by this target since the last read of this register, saturating at 255. This field can be used to track how many transactions were missed when the Target RX FIFO is full.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TARGET_ACK_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target ACK Control Register (Target Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: NBYTES
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
When `STATUS.ACK_CTRL_STRETCH = 1`, writing to this register specifies the number of bytes this target should ACK. The count decrements per byte ACKed. Effective only when `CTRL.ACK_CTRL_EN = 1`. See `CTRL.ACK_CTRL_EN` for details.
This control field is used to implement SMBus's mid-transfer (N)ACK responses.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: NACK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When `STATUS.ACK_CTRL_STRETCH = 1`, writing `1` to this field causes this target to NACK all bytes of the transaction. Effective only when `CTRL.ACK_CTRL_EN = 1`.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: ACQ_FIFO_NEXT_DATA
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target RX FIFO Next Byte Register (Target Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DATA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: This field contains the next byte to be pushed into the Target RX FIFO, allowing software to decide whether to accept or reject it. Valid only when `STATUS.ACK_CTRL_STRETCH = 1`. See `CTRL.ACK_CTRL_EN` for details.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: HOST_NACK_HANDLER_TIMEOUT
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controller NACK Timeout Register (Controller Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: VAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Timeout value (specified in system clock cycles) for this controller Mode to automatically STOP a transaction when `CONTROLLER_EVENTS.NACK` is set.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables Controller NACK Timeout.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CONTROLLER_EVENTS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controller Events Register (Controller Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: NACK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that this controller has halted due to an unexpected NACK sent by the target. This behavior can be disabled by writing `1` to `FDATA.NAKOK`. This bit triggers the `CONTROLLER_HALT` interrupt. Writing `1` clears this bit.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: UNHANDLED_NACK_TIMEOUT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that this controller has halted due to a Controller NACK Timeout. See `HOST_NACK_HANDLER_TIMEOUT` for details. This bit triggers the `CONTROLLER_HALT` interrupt. Writing `1` clears this bit.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BUS_TIMEOUT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that this controller has halted due to a Bus Timeout. See `TIMEOUT_CTRL` for details. This bit triggers the `CONTROLLER_HALT` interrupt. Writing `1` clears this bit.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ARBITRATION_LOST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that the controller has halted due to it losing an arbitration against another controller. This bit triggers the `CONTROLLER_HALT` interrupt. Writing `1` clears this bit.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TARGET_EVENTS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target Events Register (Target Mode)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_PENDING
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that the target is stretching the clock due to receiving a READ address byte and waiting for software to confirm the release of the Target TX FIFO data. Valid only if `CTRL.TX_STRETCH_CTRL_EN = 1`. See `CTRL.TX_STRETCH_CTRL_EN` for details. This bit triggers the `TX_STRETCH` interrupt. Writing `1` clears this bit.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BUS_TIMEOUT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that this target has halted due a Bus Timeout terminating a READ transaction. See `TIMEOUT_CTRL` for details. This bit triggers the `TX_STRETCH` interrupt. Writing `1` clears this bit.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ARBITRATION_LOST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that a controller has lost arbitration, causing a READ transaction to end. This bit triggers the `TX_STRETCH` interrupt. Writing `1` clears this bit.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: START_DETECT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Start Detect Flag (Target Mode only). Set to 1 by hardware when a START (or repeated START) is detected while `CTRL.ENABLETARGET = 1`. Cleared when software writes 1.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STOP_DETECT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Stop Detect Flag (Target Mode only). Set to 1 by hardware when a STOP is detected while `CTRL.ENABLETARGET = 1`. Cleared when software writes 1.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: SMBUS_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: SMBus Status Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SMBSUS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode status: indicates that the `smbsus_ni` input is asserted.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SMBALERT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode status: indicates that the `smbalert_ni` input is asserted.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: i2c_ctrl_regs
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Per-instance pad-function select, SMBus pad direction, and SMBus alert enable.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: I2C_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: I2C_EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: I2C Pad Function Select. When set, the integration routes this instance's SCL, SDA, SMBus alert and SMBus suspend signals to their pads. Does not enable the I2C core; CTRL.ENABLEHOST and CTRL.ENABLETARGET select the core's operating mode.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: I2C_CONTROLLER_MODE_EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: SMBus Pad Direction. When set, the SMBus alert pad is an input and the SMBus suspend pad is an output, as for an SMBus host. When clear, the alert pad is an output and the suspend pad is an input, as for an SMBus target. SCL and SDA are unaffected. Program it to agree with the core's CTRL.ENABLEHOST and CTRL.ENABLETARGET setting.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SMBUS_EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: SMBus Enable. Gates the SMBus Alert signal.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: smc_uart_wrap
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Wrapper address map instantiating the per-UART log-engine blocks.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: uart_log_engine_wrap
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:displayName: UART Log Engine Wrapper Address Map
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Composes the UART 16550 core, log engine, and their control registers for one UART instance.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: uart_log_engine_ctrl
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:displayName: UART Log Engine Control Address Map
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Top-level enable register for the UART log-engine block.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: UART_EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: UART Enable. When set, the pad-mux downstream will be forced to accept UART traffic.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: uart
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Contains the mode-independent registers and the read-only registers accessible only when `DLAB = 0`.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: RBR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Receiver Buffer Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DATA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Received Data. Contains a received character. If FIFOs are enabled, this field points to the bottom of the RX FIFO. Otherwise, this field points to a single- byte Receiver Buffer Register.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: IER
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt Enable Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ERBFI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable Receiver Buffer Full (Received Data Ready) Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ETBEI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable Transmitter Buffer Empty (Transmitter Holding Register Empty) Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ELSI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable (Receiver) Line Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EDSSI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable (Delta Status of) Modem Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EFEI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable FIFO Error Interrupt.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: IIR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt Identification Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: INTERRUPT_PENDING
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Interrupt Pending. Active-low.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: INTERRUPT_ID
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Interrupt ID: * `0x7` - FIFO Error Interrupt (priority 0) * `0x3` - Receiver Line Status Interrupt (priority 1) * `0x6` - Reception Timeout Interrupt (priority 2) * `0x2` - Received Data Ready Interrupt (priority 3) * `0x1` - Transmitter Holding Register Empty Interrupt (priority 4) * `0x0` - Modem Status Interrupt (priority 5)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FIFOS_ENABLED
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: FIFOs Enabled: * `0x0` - FIFOs are disabled * `0x3` - FIFOs are enabled

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: LCR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Line Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: WLS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Word Length Select: * `0x0` - 5 bits per character * `0x1` - 6 bits per character * `0x2` - 7 bits per character * `0x3` - 8 bits per character

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STB
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Stop Bits: * `0` - 1 stop bit. * `1` - 2 stop bits (or 1.5 stop bits if word length is set to 5 bits)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PEN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Parity Enable.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EPS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Even Parity Select: * `1` - even parity * `0` - odd parity

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STICK_PARITY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Stick Parity. If set, forces the transmit and received parity bits to be `0` if even parity is selected and `1` if odd parity is selected.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SET_BREAK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Set Break. If set, forces the `tx_o` output to `0` to cause a break condition on the receiving UART.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DLAB
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Divisor Latch Access Bit. If set, allows access to the `DLL` and `DLM` registers when accessing addresses `0x0` and `0x4`, respectively. If unset, allows access to the `THR`, `RBR`, and `IIR` registers.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: MCR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Modem Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DTR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Data Terminal Ready. Writing to this bit drives the `dtr_no` output in the opposite polarity.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RTS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Request to Send. Writing to this bit drives the `rts_no` output in the opposite polarity.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: OUT1
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: User Output 1. Writing to this bit drives the `out1_no` in the opposite polarity.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: OUT2
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: User Output 2. Writing to this bit drives the `out2_no` in the opposite polarity.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOOP
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: System Loopback. If set, the transmitter is internally connected to the receiver. The `tx_o` output is set to `1`.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LINE_LOOPBACK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Line Loopback. If set, the `rx_i` input is internally connected to the `tx_o` output.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: LSR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Line Status Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Data Ready. When set, indicates that the RX FIFO (or RBR in non-FIFO mode) contains data.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: OE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Overrun Error. When set, indicates that the RX FIFO (or Receiver Buffer Register in Non-FIFO Mode) is full when new character is received. In FIFO Mode, the new character is dropped. In non-FIFO mode, the existing character in the RBR is overwritten. This bit triggers the Receiver Line Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Parity Error. When set, indicates that the character at the top of the receiver FIFO (or RBR in non-FIFO mode) has a parity error. This bit triggers the Receiver Line Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Framing Error. When set, indicates that the received character is missing a stop bit. In FIFO mode, this bit is set when the character reaches the top of the FIFO. In non-FIFO mode, this bit is set when the character enters the RBR. This bit triggers the Receiver Line Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Break Interrupt. When set, indicates that the `rx_i` input is `0` for an entire frame's time (start + data + parity + stop bits). In FIFO mode, this bit set when the character reaches the top of the receiver FIFO. In non-FIFO mode, this bit is set when the character enters the RBR. This bit triggers the Receiver Line Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: THRE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Transmitter Holding Register Empty. When set, indicates that the TX FIFO (or THR in non-FIFO mode) is empty. Clearing the Transmitter Holding Register Empty Interrupt does NOT clear this bit.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TEMT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Transmitter Empty. When set, indicates that the transmitter shift register and the transmitter FIFO (or THR in non-FIFO mode) are empty.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ERROR_IN_RCVR_FIFO
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Error in Receiver FIFO. When set, indicates that the receiver FIFO or (RBR in non-FIFO mode) has the parity, framing, or break error. In other words, at least one of the PE, FE, and BI bits is set.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: MSR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Modem Status Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DCTS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Delta Clear to Send. When set, indicates that the `CTS` bit has changed since the last time this register was read. This bit triggers the Modem Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DDSR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Delta Data Set Ready. When set, indicates that the `DSR` bit has changed since the last time this register was read. This bit triggers the Modem Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TERI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Trailing Edge Ring Indicator. When set, indicates that the `RI` bit has changed from a `1` to a `0`. This bit triggers the Modem Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DDCD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Delta Data Carrier Detect. When set, indicates that the `DCD` bit has changed since the last time this register was read. This bit triggers the Modem Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CTS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear to Send. This bit reflects the `cts_ni` input in the opposite polarity, so it reads `1` while the remote device is ready to receive data.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DSR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Data Set Ready. This bit reflects the `dsr_ni` input in the opposite polarity, so it reads `1` while the remote modem is connected and ready.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Ring Indicator. This bit reflects the `ri_ni` input in the opposite polarity, so it reads `1` while the remote modem signals an incoming call.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DCD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Data Carrier Detect. This bit reflects the `dcd_ni` input in the opposite polarity, so it reads `1` while a carrier is detected.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: SCR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Scratch Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SCR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Scratch. Holds user data.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: ECR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Extended Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RCVR_TRIGGER_MS2B
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Receiver FIFO Trigger Level Most Significant 2 Bits. To configure the least significant 2 bits, use the `FCR.RCVR_TRIGGER` register field. The configurations for the trigger levels are: * `0x0` - 1 character * `0x1` - 4 characters * `0x2` - 8 characters * `0x3` - 14 characters * `0x4` - 32 characters * `0x5` - 64 characters * `0x6` - 128 characters * `0x7` - 256 characters * `0x8` - 512 characters * `0x9` - 1024 characters * `0xA` - 2048 characters * `0xB` - 4096 characters

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: ITR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt Test Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TRBFI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Test Receiver Buffer Full (Received Data Ready) Interrupt. Writing `1` forces the interrupt and writing `0` releases it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TTBEI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Test Transmitter Buffer Empty (Transmitter Holding Register Empty) Interrupt. Writing `1` forces the interrupt and writing `0` releases it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TLSI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Test (Receiver) Line Status Interrupt. Writing `1` forces the interrupt and writing `0` releases it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TDSSI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Test (Delta Status of) Modem Status Interrupt. Writing `1` forces the interrupt and writing `0` releases it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TFEI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Test FIFO Error Interrupt. Writing `1` forces the interrupt and writing `0` releases it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TRTI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Test Reception Timeout Interrupt. Writing a `1` forces the interrupt and writing `0` releases it.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: log_engine
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Configuration and status registers for the UART log engine, including the log region and write pointers.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Engine Enable. When set, enables the Log Engine. When cleared, the engine stops fetching and writing, discards buffered log data and resets transfer progress. Configuration and pending LOG_LEN values are retained, so a pending entry restarts from the start of its slot when the engine is enabled again. Clearing does not wait for outstanding bus responses.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: LOG_REGION_SIZE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Log Region Size Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_REGION_SIZE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log region size in bytes. Supported values are at most 512 KiB and aligned to 128 bytes (16 slots times the 8-byte fetch beat). If software programs a larger value, RTL clamps the effective region to 512 KiB. For a value that is not 128-byte aligned, RTL divides the effective region among the 16 slots and rounds each slot's transferable capacity down to complete 8-byte fetch beats. A requested LOG_LEN above that capacity is clamped to the capacity.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: LOG_REGION_ADDR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Log Region Address Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_REGION_ADDR_LO
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Region Start Address Low.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_REGION_ADDR_HI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Region Start Address High. Contains fabric address bits [55:32].

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RESERVED
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved. Reads as zero; writes are ignored.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: LOG_WRITE_ADDR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Log Write Address Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_WRITE_ADDR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Write Address. This is the address where the log data is written to.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: INTR_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt Status Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_FETCH_ERR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Fetch Error Interrupt. Asserted when the bus for fetching log data returns an error.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_WRITE_ERR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Write Error Interrupt. Asserted when the bus for writing log data returns an error.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: INTR_ENABLE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt Enable Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_FETCH_ERR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Fetch Error Interrupt Enable.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_WRITE_ERR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Write Error Interrupt Enable.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: INTR_TEST
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt Test Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_FETCH_ERR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Fetch Error Interrupt Test. Writing `1` forces the interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_WRITE_ERR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Write Error Interrupt Test. Writing `1` forces the interrupt.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: LOG_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Log Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_LEN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Length. Writing a nonzero value representing the log length in bytes to this field starts the log transfer process. The field holds the requested length until the transfer completes, when hardware clears it to zero; it is not a remaining-byte counter. There are 16 copies of this register, each representing a log entry. The log entries go through round robin arbitration.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: smc_efuse_map

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: JTAG_PUBLIC_IDENTITY
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: JTAG-public exception window. In PROD and RMA_SiP, JTAG reads of this range are admitted while JTAG access to every other fuse field is blocked. Encoding is adopter-defined; the harness does not interpret or consume the value. The slot-0 read lock still hides the bits when set.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: value
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Opaque payload. Encoding is adopter-defined; the harness does not interpret it.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: I2C_I3C_ID
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: I2C/I3C interface ID

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: interface_id
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: I2C or I3C ID configuration: * Static ID mode: [6:0] contains ID, [63:7] reserved * Provisional ID mode: [63:0] full ID

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: SMC_CONFIG
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: SMC boot and configuration controls sourced from fuse. Only the low word carries assigned bits, so firmware reads it as a single 32-bit access.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rom_flip_endianness
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set, the ROM interface swaps byte order on instruction fetch.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: config_rsvd_low
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved for future configuration bits.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: sram_auto_zero_disable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set, boot skips the SRAM auto-zero initialisation pass.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: config_rsvd_mid
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved for future configuration bits.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: dft_ignore_error
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set, boot continues despite a reported memory repair or MBIST failure.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: config_rsvd_high
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved for future configuration bits.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: OCCP_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: OCCP transport timeout in the low word; upper word reserved.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: timeout
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Transport timeout value consumed by the boot ROM OCCP driver.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: timeout_rsvd
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved for extension of the timeout encoding.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: SPARE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Individually lockable 256-bit spare region, reserved for fields assigned after the RTL is frozen. Each element has its own write/read lock pair in LOCKS.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rsvd
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Spare fuse bits for future use.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: efuse_interface_ctrl
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Program and read command, address, data, status, and timeout registers for the eFuse interface.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: EFUSE_INTERFACE_CTRL_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: eFuse interface status and error-clear register. Reports the sense-done flag and request/address error conditions, and provides write-1 strobes to clear those errors.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: efuse_sense_done
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates if the eFuse state machine has completed

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: efuse_req_error
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that the eFuse was blocked because of either read or a program lock. The error must be cleared by writing 1 to efuse_req_error_clear to this register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: efuse_program_addr_error
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that an invalid eFuse program address was used (address exceeds the implemented eFuse size). The error must be cleared by writing 1 to efuse_program_addr_error_clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: efuse_read_addr_error
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that an invalid eFuse read address was used (address exceeds the implemented eFuse size). The error must be cleared by writing 1 to efuse_read_addr_error_clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: efuse_req_error_clear
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clears the blocked request error bit in efuse_ctrl_status

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: efuse_program_addr_error_clear
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clears the program out of bounds error bit (efuse_program_addr_error) in efuse_ctrl_status

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: efuse_read_addr_error_clear
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clears the read out of bounds error bit (efuse_read_addr_error) in efuse_ctrl_status

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: EFUSE_PROGRAM_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: eFuse program control and status. Configures the program address and data, triggers a program (optionally with read-back), and reports program progress and completion status.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: efuse_addr
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Bit address to program

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: efuse_data
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Data to program to eFuse. If this bit is 0, the program request will be ignored

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: efuse_program_go
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set, triggers a program to the eFuse. This will be ignored if the lock bit is set

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: efuse_program_read_back
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set, trigger a read back after a program

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: program_busy
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set, the program is in progress

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: program_done
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set, the program has completed, the status of which is in program_status

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: program_status
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 0: No Error. 1: Error

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: program_enable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set, enables the program request

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: EFUSE_READ_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: eFuse read control and status. Configures the read address, triggers a read, and reports read progress and completion status.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: efuse_addr
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Bit address to read

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: efuse_read_go
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set, triggers a read to efuse.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: read_busy
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set, the read is in progress

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: read_done
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set, the read has completed, the status of which is in read_status

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: read_status
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 0: No Error. 1: Error. Set when read_go is asserted while read is not enabled, the address is out of bounds, or the read request times out.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: read_enable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set, enables the read request

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: EFUSE_PROGRAM_INTERFACE_READ_DATA
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Read data captured through the program interface. Hardware debug only; valid only while the program interface state machine is in its capture-data state.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: dout
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Read Data from eFuse through program interface. This field is only valid when the efuse programming interface is utilized to burn the efuse IP and only when the state machine is during ST_CAPTUER_DATA state. Hardware debug only

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: EFUSE_READ_INTERFACE_READ_DATA
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Read data returned through the eFuse read interface.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: dout
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Read Data from eFuse through READ interface.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: EFUSE_READ_REQ_TIMEOUT
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Read interface timeout configuration. Sets the number of cycles the read interface waits for a SHIM response and enables the read timeout.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: read_req_timeout_cycles
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of cycles the read interface will wait for a response from the shim. At 100MHz this can count ~= 2.5 seconds.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: read_req_timout_enable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable timeout on read interface

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: EFUSE_PROGRAM_REQ_TIMEOUT
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Program interface timeout configuration. Sets the number of cycles the program interface waits for a SHIM response and enables the program timeout.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: program_req_timeout_cycles
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of cycles the program interface will wait for a response from the shim. At 100MHz this can count ~= 2.5 seconds.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: program_req_timeout_enable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable timeout on program interface.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: smc_telemetry_receiver_wrap
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Wrapper address map instantiating the telemetry receiver channels.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: telemetry_receiver
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Configuration, status, and data-buffer registers for a single telemetry receiver channel.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BUFFER_POP
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Telemetry Message Buffer Pop. Effective only if `STATUS.BUFFER_EMPTY = 0`. Writing `1` pops the buffer and thus updates the data in the `TELEMETRY_PROBE_ID`, `TELEMETRY_COUNTER_VLDS`, and `TELEMETRY_COUNTER[32]` registers.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TELEMETRY_RX_FLUSH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Telemetry Receiver Flush. Writing `1` discards queued messages and resets the assembly write pointer. Stored payload bytes are not cleared. In particular, a later short message can retain trailing counter values and validity from an earlier message. This operation does not erase storage.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TELEMETRY_TX_FLUSH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Telemetry Transmitter Flush. Writing `1` flushes all FIFOs in the telemetry transmitter. The flushing is done via the ATB AF interface. This bit clears itself after the flush completes.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BUFFER_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Telemetry Message Buffer Threshold. The Telemetry Buffer Threshold Interrupt is asserted when the number of entries in the buffer is greater than this value. Only the low log2(queue depth)+1 bits are compared, so values alias modulo twice the queue depth, and only values below the queue depth can assert the interrupt.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Status Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BUFFER_EMPTY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Telemetry Message Buffer Empty.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BUFFER_FULL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Telemetry Message Buffer Full.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: INTR_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt Status Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MISSING_LAST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Last Packet Missing Interrupt. Asserted when the Telemetry Receiver has not received a Last Packet flag when the maximum number of packets a message can consist of has been received.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BUFFER_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Telemetry Message Buffer Threshold Interrupt. Asserted when the number of telemetry messages in the Telemetry Message Buffer is greater than `CTRL.BUFFER_THRESHOLD`.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: INTR_ENABLE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt Enable Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MISSING_LAST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Last Packet Missing Interrupt Enable.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BUFFER_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Telemetry Message Buffer Threshold Interrupt Enable.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: INTR_TEST
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt Test Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MISSING_LAST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Last Packet Missing Interrupt Test. Writing `1` forces the interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BUFFER_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Telemetry Message Buffer Threshold Interrupt Test. Writing `1` forces the interrupt and writing `0` releases it.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TELEMETRY_PROBE_ID
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Telemetry Probe ID Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PROBE_ID
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Probe ID. Contains the Probe ID field of the telemetry message at the bottom of the Telemetry Message Buffer.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TELEMETRY_COUNTER_VLDS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Telemetry Counter Valid Bits Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: COUNTER_VLDS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Counter Valid Bits. Indicates which of the counter values in the telemetry message at the bottom of the Telemetry Message Buffer are valid. Bit `i` is for the `i`-th counter.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TELEMETRY_COUNTER
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Telemetry Counter Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: COUNTER
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Counter Value. Contains one of the 32 counter values in the telemetry message at the bottom of the Telemetry Message Buffer.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: smc_system_timer_octs
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Open Chiplet Time Synchronization (OCTS) System Timer Registers

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMER_START
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: System Timer Start Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: START
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Start the system timer. In PRIMARY mode, a write of 1 loads the preset and pulses the sync-load output for PULSE_WIDTH cycles. In SECONDARY mode, the write has no effect; a secondary starts on the primary's sync-load pulse, which is what loads its preset. Ensure both primary and secondary are out of reset.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: System Timer Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CREDIT_VAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Credit value factor. WARNING: This value must be greater than PULSE_WIDTH

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PULSE_WIDTH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Pulse width for sync load and credit signals. A value of 0 will be rounded up to 1. WARNING: This value must be less than CREDIT_VAL

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STEP
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Step amount for secondary timer

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: System Timer Status Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MODE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Timer mode driven by the is_primary_i input: 0=PRIMARY (is_primary_i=1), 1=SECONDARY (is_primary_i=0).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RUNNING
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Timer is enabled and its count is nonzero.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMER_PRESET_LO
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: System Timer Preset Value [31:0]

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PRESET_LO
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Lower 32 bits of preset value

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMER_PRESET_HI
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: System Timer Preset Value [63:32]

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PRESET_HI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Upper 32 bits of preset value

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMER_COUNT_LO
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Current System Timer Count [31:0]

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: COUNT_LO
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Lower 32 bits of current timer count

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMER_COUNT_HI
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Current System Timer Count [63:32]

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: COUNT_HI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Upper 32 bits of current timer count

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CREDIT_EXPIRED
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Credit Expired Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MAX_CYCLES_EXPIRED
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Maximum number of clock cycles since a count credit expired (SECONDARY only). To reset the value of this register, write anything to it. If this number is very high (exact value depends on clock speed and credit value), this indicates that the secondary has not received a count credit pulse in a while, and is likely not syncing properly with the primary. This register can also be used to determine the clock skew between the primary and secondary. If PRIMARY, this field is always 0.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMER_GPIO_ENABLE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: System Timer GPIO Enable Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: GPIO_ENABLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable the GPIO pad lsio interface for the system timer. This is done to prevent X-prop on reset into the secondary timer, which can cause the secondary timer to start counting early.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: dfx_ctrl
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:displayName: DFX Control and Status Address Map
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Memory-repair and MBIST status, debug clock and cross-trigger controls, and debug-mux selects.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: mem_repair_done
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: One bit indicator from DFT logic to say when mem repair is completed. This register is sticky 1 and will hold the value until reset

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: mem_repair_success
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: One bit indicator from DFT logic to say if mem repair was successful This register is sticky 1 and will hold the value until reset

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: mem_repair_abort
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: One bit indicator from DFT logic to say that mem repair has hit timeout and aborted This register is sticky 1 and will hold the value until reset

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: mbist_done
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: One bit indicator from DFT logic to say when MBIST is completed This register is sticky 1 and will hold the value until reset

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: mbist_pass
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: One bit indicator from DFT logic to say when MBIST is successful This register is sticky 1 and will hold the value until reset

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: mbist_abort
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: One bit indicator from DFT logic to say that MBIST has hit timeout and aborted This register is sticky 1 and will hold the value until reset

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: chiplet_enable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Holds the written value for software to read back. It has no effect in the SMC.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: gpio_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Holds the written value for software to read back. It has no effect in the SMC.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: DFD clock stop. 1 stops the clock to the debug-bus muxes and the CLA unless force_clk_en is 1; 0 lets it run. The clock also runs while the SMC is in reset. While the clock is stopped, CLA and DST register accesses complete with an error and reads return 0xBADCAB1E.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: force_clk_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Design-for-debug (DFD) clock force. 1 keeps the DFD clock running whatever the value of cg_en.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: dtb_ns_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Holds the written value for software to read back. It has no effect in the SMC.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: dtb_ew_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Holds the written value for software to read back. It has no effect in the SMC.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: xtrig_clk_halt_mask
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: CLA cross-trigger and halt-clock enable. Bit 0 (register bit 7) enables every CLA cross-trigger output lane together with the CLA halt-clock request; 0 holds them all inactive. Bits 15:1 hold the written value for software to read back and have no effect.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: debug_marker
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Holds the written value for software to read back. It has no effect in the SMC; the debug marker on the SMC debug bus comes from the core logic analyzer (CLA).

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: DEBUG_BUS_MUX
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Mode, ID and lane selects for the twelve debug-bus muxes that reduce the SMC debug bus to the 16 CLA input lanes. Each mux takes its mode while Dbmid equals its ID, and its lane selects while Dbmid equals its ID and its mode is 1, so program one mux at a time.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Dbmmode
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Mode selection, 0: DBM off, 1: Normal debug mode, 2: DBM ID output mode, 3: Toggle Mode

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Dbmid
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: ID of the debug-bus mux to program: 3 to 6 address the level-2 muxes and 7 to 14 the level-3 muxes.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Muxselseg0
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Binary input-lane select for output lane 0 of the addressed debug-bus mux, which takes eight 16-bit input lanes and drives four. 0 selects input lane 0; a value k from 1 to 4 selects input lane k+3, so 4 selects lane 7; 5 to 63 drive zero.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Muxselseg1
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Binary input-lane select for output lane 1 of the addressed debug-bus mux, which takes eight 16-bit input lanes and drives four. 0 selects input lane 1; a value k from 1 to 4 selects input lane k+3, so 4 selects lane 7; 5 to 63 drive zero.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Muxselseg2
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Binary input-lane select for output lane 2 of the addressed debug-bus mux, which takes eight 16-bit input lanes and drives four. 0 selects input lane 2; a value k from 1 to 4 selects input lane k+3, so 4 selects lane 7; 5 to 63 drive zero.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Muxselseg3
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Binary input-lane select for output lane 3 of the addressed debug-bus mux, which takes eight 16-bit input lanes and drives four. 0 selects input lane 3; a value k from 1 to 4 selects input lane k+3, so 4 selects lane 7; 5 to 63 drive zero.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Muxselseg4
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: No effect in the SMC: each debug-bus mux has four output lanes, selected by Muxselseg0 to Muxselseg3.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Muxselseg5
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: No effect in the SMC: each debug-bus mux has four output lanes, selected by Muxselseg0 to Muxselseg3.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Muxselseg6
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: No effect in the SMC: each debug-bus mux has four output lanes, selected by Muxselseg0 to Muxselseg3.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Muxselseg7
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: No effect in the SMC: each debug-bus mux has four output lanes, selected by Muxselseg0 to Muxselseg3.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: smc_base_config
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Base-address, region-size, per-block clock-gating enable, and interrupt configuration registers.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: base
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global base address for the CPU

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: base
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Local base address for the CPU

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: size
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Region size for SMC resources, sizing both the local alias window and the global aperture. Must be a non-zero power of two: the fabric derives its local-alias address mask as (size - 1), so any other value produces a discontiguous mask and misroutes accesses. Zero leaves no reachable local aperture. GLOBAL_BASE and LOCAL_BASE must be aligned to this size. Inbound accesses to a unit whose window extends past this size answer DECERR. Defaults to 16MB (0x100_0000); FW reprograms per chiplet spec.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: dma_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clockgate enable for the DMA

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: mailbox_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clockgate enable for the mailbox

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: filter_ob_axi_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clockgate enable for the outbound filters

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: filter_ob_reg_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clockgate enable for outbound filter registers

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: filter_ib_axi_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clockgate enable for the inbound filters

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: filter_ib_reg_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clockgate enable for inbound filter registers

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: addr_remap_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clock gate enable for address remapper register logic

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: output_fabric_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clock gate enable for the output fabric remap demux and mux

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: zeroer_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clock gate enable for axi zeroer

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: i3c_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clock gate enable for I3C. While set, the I3C peripheral clock is stopped and every access to the OCA_I3C_WRAP window answers SLVERR with read data 0xBADCAB1E.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: avs_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clock gate enable for AVSBus. While set, the AVSBus controller clocks are stopped and every access to the SMC_AVSBUS_CONTROLLER window answers SLVERR with read data 0xBADCAB1E.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: i2c_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clock gate enable for I2C. While set, the I2C peripheral clock is stopped and every access to the SMC_I2C_WRAP window answers SLVERR with read data 0xBADCAB1E.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: uart_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clock gate enable for UART. While set, the UART peripheral clock is stopped and every access to the SMC_UART_WRAP window answers SLVERR with read data 0xBADCAB1E.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: telemetry_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clock gate enable for telemetry. While set, the telemetry receiver clocks are stopped and every access to the SMC_TELEMETRY_RECEIVER_WRAP window answers SLVERR with read data 0xBADCAB1E.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: cg_hysteresis
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clockgate cg_hysteresis

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: HANG_DET_SYS_AXI_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: AXI hang detector control and interrupt status.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: enable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When 1, the timeout counter runs. When 0, the counter reloads from the threshold and irq_o is forced low.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: irq_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Interrupt enable. When irq_en and enable are high, irq_o follows the detector; when 0, irq_o is held low. Gates a real timeout and irq_test alike.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: irq_test
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Interrupt test. When 1, asserts irq_o without a bus stall, so firmware can exercise the interrupt path. Gated by enable and irq_en: it substitutes for the timeout, it does not override the interrupt enable.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: irq
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reads 1 while this detector's interrupt is asserted, from a timeout or from irq_test, and 0 while enable or irq_en is clear. A live level, not a latch: it clears when the interrupt drops. Writes are ignored.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: HANG_DET_SYS_AXI_TIMEOUT_THRESHOLD
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Consecutive cycles with outstanding AXI transactions and no completion before a timeout fires.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: value
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Threshold in clock cycles. Default 0x1000. 20 bits => up to ~1M cycles (~1ms at 1GHz). 0 disables timeout detection: a stalled bus never asserts irq_o, though irq_test still asserts it. A threshold write takes effect when the stall count next restarts (on a completion, an idle bus, or enable cleared). So it does not change a stall already being timed.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: smc_alias_remap
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: TLB Registers for address remapping and attribute tagging

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: start_addr
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Start of remap region

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: end_addr
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: End of remap region (non-inclusive).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: offset
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The value of this field is added to bits [55:12] of the input address when it falls within the remap region. The lower 12 bits of the address are preserved unchanged.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: cacheable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Set to change the value of the axcache field of the transaction. This field will override all existing axcache bits.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: valid
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: If set, this remap will be active

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: smc_mmode_remap
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Address-translation registers that remap outbound transactions and tag their attributes.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: offset
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Address translation for remap region. RTL will use the number of bits appropriate for region granulaity. e.g. SMC: 8 * 1MB regions --> 20 bits of address space per region, 36 MSBs from this register used SEP: 16 * 512KB regions --> 19 bits of address space per region, 37 MSBs from this register used

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: valid
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: If set, accesses to this region are remapped by offset; if clear, they pass through with their address unchanged

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: smc_xvisor_remap
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Address-translation registers that remap outbound transactions and tag their attributes.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: offset
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Address translation for remap region. RTL will use the number of bits appropriate for region granulaity. e.g. SMC: 8 * 1MB regions --> 20 bits of address space per region, 36 MSBs from this register used SEP: 16 * 512KB regions --> 19 bits of address space per region, 37 MSBs from this register used

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: valid
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: If set, accesses to this region are remapped by offset; if clear, they pass through with their address unchanged

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: smc_inbound_filter_ctrl
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Per-filter access-control registers defining permitted address ranges and transaction attributes.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: read_allowed
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Upon match of transaction to filter fields, whether the transaction has read permissions

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: write_allowed
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Upon match of transaction to filter fields, whether the transaction has write permissions

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: entry_enabled
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Filter entry enabled. A = 0 means this entry is disabled, A = 1 means this entry is enabled and will be used to filter

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: allow_ns
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Secure and Non-secure is categorized as AxPROT[1] in the AXI protocol, where AxPROT[1] == 0 means secure and AxPROT[1] == 1 means Non-secure. Filter entry will match if AxPROT[1] matches the value in this field

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: data_bus_width
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Data bus width in bytes, encoded as 2^value

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: src_id
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Source ID field to match. Filter entry will match if the transactions src_id matches the value in this field. A value of 0 in this field is a wildcard: src_id matching is bypassed and the entry matches any src_id. Consequently there is no way to match only transactions whose src_id is 0.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: group_id
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Group ID field to match. Filter entry will match if the transactions group_id matches the value in this field. Note the corner case is the opposite of src_id: the bypass keys off the transaction, not this field. A transaction whose group_id is 0 matches regardless of this field, and a value of 0 here is not a wildcard. Unused for SEP/SMC, where group_id filtering is disabled at build time and this field has no effect

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: allow_burst
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Filter entry will match if this field is 1 or if this field is 0 and the burst len AxLEN is 0. This field also selects the granule of the address range: 4KB when it is 1, 2^data_bus_width bytes when it is 0. See start_addr and end_addr for how the range is widened to that granule.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: locked
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Lock filter configurations. Write once register. Once set, this bit cannot be cleared, and every subsequent write to this filter entry's FILTER_CONFIG, START_ADDR and END_ADDR registers is steered to the AXI error subordinate and terminates with a DECERR response; reads still return the locked configuration.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: start_addr
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Start of the allowable address range, rounded down to the base of its granule. The granule is 4KB when allow_burst is 1, and 2^data_bus_width bytes when allow_burst is 0. Address matching ignores the address bits below the granule, so the accepted range always spans whole granules and is never narrower than one: a range shorter than the granule, start_addr == end_addr included, still admits the whole granule, and two granules if it straddles a granule boundary. Hardware writes the rounded start_addr and end_addr back into these fields only when both land in the same granule; otherwise readback returns the programmed values even though matching is still granule-aligned.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: end_addr
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: End of the allowable address range, rounded up to the top of its granule. The granule and the write-back behaviour are described under start_addr. Defaults to 7 on reset to match the 8B granule that applies while bursts are disabled.

ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Group ID field to match. Filter entry will match if the transactions group_id matches the value in this field. Note the corner case is the opposite of src_id: the bypass keys off the transaction, not this field. A transaction whose group_id is 0 matches regardless of this field, and a value of 0 here is not a wildcard.
